definitions.explanation: A flat, folding wallet designed primarily for holding paper currency, as distinguished from coin purses or general-purpose wallets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{札入|さつい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
{札入|さつい}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}→一万円札：26562_ichimanensatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三枚|さんまい}⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There are three 10,000-yen bills in my billfold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{札入|さつい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gave my father a leather billfold for his birthday.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧ (banknote, bill) and ⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (container, holder). Refers specifically to the flat, folding type of wallet designed primarily for holding paper money. Distinguished from coin purses and more general wallets.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{札入|さつい}れ: leather billfold
- {長|なが}{札入|さつい}れ: long wallet
- {二|ふた}つ{折|お}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{札入|さつい}れ: bi-fold wallet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧: wallet, purse — the general and most common term; can hold bills, coins, and cards
- ⟦{小銭入|こぜにい}れ→小銭入れ：20896_kozeniire⟧: coin purse — specifically for coins
- ⟦{長財布|ながさいふ}→長財布：27564_nagasaifu⟧: long wallet — the modern common term for a wallet that holds bills flat
